description: Get aggregate trading performance metrics over a time range: ROI, win rate, total P&L, and Sortino ratio. Use it to summarize how the user (or a subset of their trading) is performing. Read-only. For a list of individual trades use get_trade_history.

exchangeId.description: Optional filter to a single exchange account ID (from list_exchanges). Omit for all.

timeRange.description: Window for the metrics: today, 7d, 30d, or 90d. Defaults to 30d.

tradeType.description: Optional filter: "live" or "paper" trades only. Omit to include both.

name: get_performance_metrics
